author: Codex
notes: Assistant-authored candidate labels. Held-out cases are reserved from prompt tuning; no human-reviewed baseline is claimed. Review against full source sections before acceptance.

cases.question: In SSD2, does GBR27 require resUnit when resType is BIN? What does GBR28 require?
rubric: State that GBR27 applies when resType differs from BIN.
GBR28 requires resQualValue for BIN.
Mention GBR29 if numeric limits are present; do not say BIN never needs units.

cases.question: For VMPR reporting, do F01 and F02 always have to be supplied, including feed, water and processed food?
rubric: Do not make F01/F02 universal. Preserve feed/water and processed/composite exceptions.
Do not confuse F01/F02 exceptions with absence of all matrix requirements.

cases.question: I have additive information from labels, laboratory results and manufacturers. Can I submit all three with the same data model?
rubric: Distinguish SSD2 analytical results, no-presence collection and use-levels collection.
Ask which type of record is being submitted if necessary; do not apply USE rules universally.
cases.source_review_notes: ChemMon 2026 and parallel guidance introductions; draft route classification needs human review

cases.question: For 2026 no-presence data, an implicit F33 is already present. Is another explicit F33 an Error?
rubric: Identify PRE15 as Warning; explicit F33 is not needed if implicit.
Do not call it USE23 or a submission-blocking Error.

cases.question: For 2026 use-level data, may I add an explicit F33 that is already implicit in matCode?
rubric: USE23 prohibits the duplicate and is an Error.
Keep matCode and use-level data distinct from sampMatCode/PRE15.

cases.question: For 2026 analytical SSD2 food-additive results, what happens if I repeat the implicit F33?
rubric: CHEMON109 (wiki CHEMMON109) is a Warning in 2026.
Do not turn a possible 2027 change into the 2026 rule.

cases.question: For a processed pesticide sample, do LL_01_PPP and LL_02_PPP apply in the same way as for an unprocessed sample?
rubric: State that these rule definitions require an unprocessed sample.
Preserve VAL and W002A-or-empty conditions; do not claim processing makes every legal obligation disappear.

cases.question: For a contaminant result with evalCode J003A in 2026, is omission of actTakenCode an Error under CHEMON37?
rubric: CHEMON37 is a Warning, and actTakenCode should be reported.
Do not transfer CHEMON85 VMPR/pesticide requirements to contaminants.

cases.question: Is F03 mandatory for my additive data?
rubric: Request reporting path, category and whether F03 is implicit before a categorical answer.
Distinguish SSD2 recommendations from PRE/USE conditional requirements.

cases.question: What is the weather in Stockholm tomorrow?
rubric: Say the supplied evidence cannot answer; do not invent a weather forecast or cite a reporting page.
cases.source_review_notes: Out of scope of all four supplied source documents

cases.question: Does GBR101 reject any repeated paramCode and sampAnId, or can portions and Not in list change the outcome?
rubric: Include paramCode.base, sampId, sampAnId and anPortSeq in the uniqueness key.
Preserve exception RF-XXXX-XXX-XXX.

cases.question: Which F23 target-consumer code does the 2026 VMPR guidance use for sheep/goat feed?
rubric: Report grouped code A07VF.
If listing children, use A18ET, A18EV, A18EX and A18EY; do not repeat the PDF typo.
Distinguish catalogue correction from original PDF wording.
cases.source_review_notes: ChemMon 2026 p. 36; local catalogue query in reports/source-review

cases.question: Can a sample coded under baby-food A03PZ be reported with VMPR progLegalRef N371A?
rubric: CHEMON63 excludes N371A for samples under A03PZ.
Do not infer that all other collections exclude baby food.

cases.question: In the 2026 no-presence collection, what repYear and sampY should I report, and is repYear mandatory?
rubric: repYear optional; if present 2026.
sampY is mandatory and expected 2025 for this collection.
Do not substitute USE marketing-year rules.

cases.question: Why do use-level data need marketYear, marketMonth and marketDay rather than just a reporting year?
rubric: All three marketing-date fields are mandatory.
Explain legal-limit checks use the marketing date; repYear is the collection year.

cases.question: What changed in EFSA chemical-monitoring reporting for the 2028 collection?
rubric: State that the supplied 2026 sources do not establish 2028 rules.
Do not present anticipated future transitions as verified 2028 guidance.
